title: Encoding commutes with gate duality
statement: For every directed acyclic circuit $C$, applying the bit-string transformation that swaps AND and OR gate kinds to the encoding of $C$ gives the encoding of the circuit obtained by exchanging AND and OR at every gate while leaving NOT gates and all gate arguments unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a directed acyclic circuit on $n$ input vertices
